description.value: The Pawn Shop YVR is an East L.A.-inspired taco and tequila bar on Vancouver's Granville Street, featuring hand-painted graffiti walls, cozy bench seating, and an open-concept kitchen. The menu spans tacos, burritos, rice bowls, and handcrafted tequila cocktails, with multiple vegetarian and gluten-free items clearly marked throughout. A touring cyclist arriving in Vancouver's entertainment district will find a lively full-service sit-down meal with delivery options also available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 23m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m; stands (4 spaces) at 82m; stands (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was fully accessible and confirms an active East L.A.-inspired taco and tequila bar at 1117 Granville St, Vancouver, corroborating the OSM address and URL. The menu explicitly marks multiple items with (V+GF), (V), and (VT) flags, and the site links to DoorDash, UberEats, and an in-house online order page, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content, leaving those fields null.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Pawn Shop' but the business consistently uses 'The Pawn Shop YVR' on its website, domain, and branding.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 12:00-17:00) conflict significantly with website hours (Tuesday–Sunday, closed Mondays); the OSM hours appear outdated and inaccurate.
Phone number 604-687-7474 is confirmed on the website but absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant with confirmed vegetarian and GF menu options and multiple takeout channels, in a central Vancouver location useful to touring cyclists passing through the city.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks Chips & Salsa, Chips & Guac, and Salsa Flight as (V+GF); Tater Tots as (V); Street Corn, Green Goddess bowl, and Jalapeño Poppers as (VT). Cauliflower substitution offered on meat dishes
